name: candidus-reels
description: Candidus Gestão Financeira — vídeos em motion design (Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render CandidusReel01 out/candidus-reel-01-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p && bash scripts/finalize.sh
scripts.render:sem-legendas: remotion render CandidusReel01 out/candidus-reel-01-sem-legendas-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --props='{"captions":false}' && bash scripts/finalize.sh out/candidus-reel-01-sem-legendas-raw.mp4 out/candidus-reel-01-sem-legendas.mp4
